body:
One long-lived bash under `ptyprocess`/`pexpect`, so `cd` and `export` persist between commands. Detect command completion and exit codes reliably.

**Done when:** `cd /tmp` then `pwd` prints `/tmp`; exit codes are captured; a hung command can be interrupted with Ctrl-C.

---
**Design review 2026-10-14** (#63)

- **Depends on** #65 (PTY protocol) and #19.
- Sharpened done-when: completion and exit code come from OSC 133 markers with a per-session value (#65); adversarial rows: output that prints a marker, a command with no output, a background job, a here-doc, multi-line input.
- Update the threat model's "How to exercise it" section when this lands.
title: M0.2 — Persistent bash in a PTY
